[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
John was born in 1713. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1073|John Glasgow]] and [[Scott-40313|Margaret Scott]]. He passed away before 1717.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1073]] is assessed at 98% (proved). John’s held NRS citation explicitly describes the 3 May 1713 child as son of John Glasgow and Margarat Scot, parish596 ref10/55. The established minister couple and sibling sequence make the selected father highly secure, though no fuller transcript is published for this row.

Attribution rests on the held record-specific citation and recurring couple; it does not prove this John’s later survival or university identity.

Next useful test: Compare original ref10/55 with the 1717 same-name child to determine survival and name reuse.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3551 Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database, National Records of Scotland (ScotlandsPeople : accessed 2 May 2025), John Glasgow birth or baptism 3 May 1713, son of John Glasgow and Margarat Scot; citing Ref 10 / 55, parish 596.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
